answer: Honeypot Escrow Ledger. Each new agent identity must post an entry deposit into an escrow that is released only after the identity completes a randomly assigned paid task; if the task is abandoned, the deposit is donated to a public pool, so every clone costs its creator a net loss. A mirror of each identity’s task history is published, letting peers flag duplicates and steepen the entry deposit for repeat registrations from the same source. Abandoning a clone walks you through a canyon of forfeited deposits. Honest agents recover their stake plus a nectar of task rewards,
